qqKeys: Fill in the QQ bot's AppID and AppSecret (on the bot management page at q.qq.com).
unreadSecrets: The saved login cannot be read: disconnect and connect again
expired: The login expired: try again in an hour, or disconnect and connect again.
paired: Paired: what you say here from now on is what you say in the default channel.
inboundMismatch: The inbound record's id does not match

feishu.noQr: Feishu does not support making an app by scanning right now: try again later.
feishu.noLink: Feishu gave no QR code: try again.
feishu.incomplete: Feishu confirmed, but did not give the whole login: try again.
feishu.tooLong: Not scanned in time: the QR code expired.
feishu.noId: Feishu send: no message id confirmed

qq.badKeys: the AppID or AppSecret is wrong
qq.reconnect: QQ gateway: QQ asked to reconnect
qq.invalid: QQ gateway: QQ says the session is invalid
qq.unread: QQ send: the result cannot be read: {why}
qq.noId: QQ send: no message id confirmed {why}

weixin.noQr: Could not get the login QR code: {why}
weixin.qrExpiredTimes: The QR code expired several times: start again.
weixin.codeWrongTimes: The digits were wrong several times: start again.
weixin.taken: This WeChat is already connected: delete it in WeChat first, or scan with another WeChat.
weixin.incomplete: WeChat confirmed, but did not give the whole login: try again.
weixin.tooLong: Not scanned in time: the QR code expired.
